headline: Gannon finish the regular season top of the table
dek: Gannon won at E. Stroudsburg on Sunday and finished the regular season top of the table, with fourteen wins, three draws and three defeats across all their matches. E. Stroudsburg had arrived from clean-sheet wins at Lock Haven and Millersville, and could not find a way past the leaders.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Gannon have scored more than California (Pa.) and Shippensburg together but conceded 24, so theirs is a lead in goals scored, not in goals kept out.

wire.line: Lock Haven, West Chester and Millersville finish level on points behind Gannon at the top.
